tytul: Horseradish ćwikła (beetroot and horseradish relish): why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for horseradish ćwikła: JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for it.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to Oregon State University Extension, a recipe for fresh or quick pack pickles must call for vinegar of 5% acidity and have at least as much vinegar as water, unless it is an OSU or USDA tested recipe.
Use only vinegar labelled 5% acidity; white and cider vinegar can be used interchangeably; do not use wine vinegars, homemade vinegar or lemon juice.
Untested recipes can be prepared and stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks; do not store them on the counter.

akapity: According to an RMF24 recipe, ćwikła uses a tablespoon of vinegar or lemon juice, and the horseradish is covered with 5–6 tablespoons of boiling water.
That recipe has less vinegar than water and allows lemon juice instead of vinegar.
It gives no number of days in the refrigerator.
Beetroot and horseradish are vegetables, and all fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6.
JarAtlas has a card for the tested NCHFP horseradish sauce, which is kept in the refrigerator and is not canned.
